metadata.title: That 2 kill spree where my aim clocked in for 2 seconds and enemy just quit LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did my aim take a coffee break or actually work?
Enemies vanished like it was magic.
Click if your best plays are total chaos with zero effort!
Valorant logic doing its weird magic again.

Tap in if your aim’s usually AFK but kills still drop!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
